title: Approximation by quasi-projection operators and dual wavelet frames in Sobolev spaces
summary: For a quasi-projection operator $Q_j(f,φ, \widetildeφ)$ formed by a compactly supported function $φ$ and a compactly supported distribution $\widetildeφ$ with dilation matrix $M$, we establish necessary and sufficient conditions under which it provides prescribed simultaneous approximation and simultaneous density orders for a function $f$ from the Sobolev space $H^s({\mathbb R}^d)$ and for its derivatives. The obtained criteria are then used to endow MRA-based dual wavelet frames in a pair of dual Sobolev spaces with the desired simultaneous approximation properties.
